source_ablation.note: Source-ablation (M2): same spatial H3-block CV (parent-resolution offset = 2 → R7 blocks, 5 folds, GBM) refit to multiple target definitions and feature subsets to test construct validity of the binary union evidence target ((dep_area_frac>0)|(complaint>0)|(hwm>0)); includes physics-only vs reporting-only vs full models (P1-1). ROC-AUC is the headline ranking-discrimination metric; accuracy/F1 are threshold-dependent. Single-class targets are not fitted.

lower_manhattan.buffer_note: Metre guard bands (0/250/500/1000 m, EPSG:2263) purge training cells within the buffer of any held-out cell; at R7 blocks the block-level separation already exceeds 1 km, so the retained-train fraction stays 1.0 and the metre buffer is a no-op (reported honestly, with the measured min train-test distance). The h3_grid_disk_k1/k2 rows are the guard band that actually removes adjacent-block cells.

manhattan_expanded.buffer_note: Metre guard bands (0/250/500/1000 m, EPSG:2263) purge training cells within the buffer of any held-out cell; at R7 blocks the block-level separation already exceeds 1 km, so the retained-train fraction stays 1.0 and the metre buffer is a no-op (reported honestly, with the measured min train-test distance). The h3_grid_disk_k1/k2 rows are the guard band that actually removes adjacent-block cells.

slr_sensitivity.note: Sea-level sensitivity (M4): the composite target is re-assembled with the DEP 'Moderate Flood with 2050 Sea Level Rise' layer (Layer 2, same Flooding_Category 1-2 filtering) and compared against the current-sea-level primary (Layer 1) under the same spatial H3-block CV (k=2 parent blocks, 5 folds, GBM). Both DEP variants are H&H model outputs.

adaptive.note: Cell-count accounting only (deployment_full in-sample selection); not a runtime/efficiency claim. hotspot_refinement_recall counts a uniform-R11 hotspot as recalled only if that R11 cell was actually refined (the legacy coverage recall was a tautology).

rows.note: True R11 feature re-extraction on refined parents' children using the deployment model; cells with NaN static features (DEM edge) are dropped before scoring. hotspot_refinement_recall counts a uniform-R11 hotspot as recalled ONLY if that R11 cell was actually refined (not merely covered by an unrefined R9 parent) — the old hotspot_recall was a coverage tautology. Best/worst-case bounds treat DEM-edge-missing hotspots as hits/misses respectively.

negative_control.note: coastal overlay is a negative control, not a training label; metrics are on the live open-data stack (still Lower Manhattan / stated bbox, not citywide; not PFIb)

sandy_311_window_sensitivity.note: 311 complaints with created_date in the Sandy landfall window [2012-10-27, 2012-11-05] are excluded before rebuilding the composite max(dep, complaint, hwm) target. Coastal diagnostic still uses OOF model scores from the primary (unmodified) CV, never the target score.

oof_extended_metrics.hyperparameter_provenance: GBM hyperparameters (n_estimators=80, max_depth=4, learning_rate=0.08, seed=42) are pre-specified in src/pluvial_flood_risk/config.py and estimators.py with no nested CV retuning.
oof_extended_metrics.urban_flag_note: land_cover_urban removed from FEATURE_COLUMNS / estimator inputs (deterministic copy of impervious_frac; no independent information).

land_mask_sensitivity.note: True land-mask sensitivity on Option B LM using NHDPlus water polygons (NHDArea/NHDWaterbody) from hydro_streams.geojson. land_frac = 1 - (cell ∩ water)/cell_area; centroid_on_land excludes cell centres inside water polygons. Primary spatial CV recomputed per mask.

polygon_area_threshold_sensitivity.note: Binary union target with the DEP polygon term swept over area-fraction thresholds 0 / 1% / 5% / 10%; 311 and Ida HWM presence unchanged. The continuous companion is the DEP-only coverage proxy, never a cross-source max.

hwm_quality_oof_validation.note: Quality-filtered OOF score validation on expanded-pilot HWM cells (Excellent/Good in ida_hwm_quality), plus USGS height_above_gnd diagnostic and per-point HWM quality ranks. n is very small: diagnostic only.

hwm_quality_ranks.note: Diagnostic only. Only a handful of raw HWM points fall inside the modelling domain, so per-point quality ranks characterise the layer; they are not a quantitative validation of the model.

height_above_gnd_diagnostic.note: Diagnostic only: USGS HWM height_above_gnd vs expanded-pilot OOF probability; not used as a training target.

hwm_validation.note: Quality-filtered OOF score validation on expanded-pilot HWM cells (Excellent/Good in ida_hwm_quality), plus USGS height_above_gnd diagnostic and per-point HWM quality ranks. n is very small: diagnostic only.

height_above_gnd_diagnostic.note: Diagnostic only: USGS HWM height_above_gnd vs expanded-pilot OOF probability; not used as a training target.

lower_manhattan.note: Operating threshold selected by maximising F1 on the training fold only, then applied to the held-out fold. Never tuned on test.

provenance.note: analysis_source_commit is the commit of this working analysis tree; snapshot_repository_commit is the commit of the flat review snapshot published to GitHub. They coincide until the flat snapshot is rebuilt.

external_validation.outcome_definition: Study R9 cell is positive if it contains >=1 FloodNet sensor with >=1 pre-freeze QC street-flooding event in aq7i-eu5q; scores are spatial-CV OOF susceptibility ranks from the open-evidence model (FloodNet excluded from training).
external_validation.interpretation: NEGATIVE external result: independent FloodNet event-level discrimination was NOT established (AUC can be < 0.5). Reported honestly.
